other_mijikenda: Giriama, Duruma: Muhuhu (Pakia notes the name is shared by Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili)

teaser.en: Second only to African blackwood for carving, this fragrant wood has become so scarce that carvers may cut only a few trees.
teaser.sw: Kwa uchongaji, ni wa pili tu baada ya mpingo; mbao hii yenye harufu nzuri imekuwa adimu kiasi kwamba wachongaji wanaruhusiwa kukata miti michache tu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa kutsonga, mbao zenye arufu nono za muhi uhu zinatsupwa ni mphingo tu, na sambi ni adimu hata atu anaotsonga anaruhusiwa kukata mihi michache tu.

summary.en: *Muhuhu* is an evergreen tree of dry coastal forest whose hard, fragrant wood is second only to African blackwood for carving. Heavy cutting has made it Near Threatened, and mature trees now survive mostly in protected areas.
summary.sw: *Muhuhu* ni mti wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima unaopatikana katika misitu mikavu ya pwani, na mbao yake ngumu yenye harufu nzuri ni ya pili tu baada ya mpingo kwa uchongaji. Ukataji mwingi umeufanya kuwa Karibu Kuwa Hatarini, na miti iliyokomaa sasa imebaki hasa katika maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa.
summary.dg: *Muhuhu* ni muhi usiogbwa makodza wa matsaka makavu ga pwani, ambao mbaoze ngumu zenye arufu nono zinatsupwa ni mphingo tu kpwa kutsonga. Kukatwa sana kukahenda ukale *Near Threatened* (phephi na kukala hatarini), na mihi mikulu sambi inasala zaidi kpwenye maeneo ga hifadhi.

about.en: *Muhuhu* is an evergreen tree 8 to 15 metres tall, with branches that climb steeply upward. The leaves are spear-shaped, shiny above and covered in white felt below, so the tree flashes silvery-grey when the wind turns the leaves. The bark is grey and fibrous, peeling away in strips.
about.sw: *Muhuhu* ni mti wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima wenye urefu wa mita 8 hadi 15, na matawi yanayopanda juu kwa mwinuko mkali. Majani yake yana umbo la mkuki, yanang'aa upande wa juu na yamefunikwa na manyoya meupe upande wa chini, hivyo mti humeta rangi ya kijivu-fedha upepo unapoyageuza majani. Gome lake ni la kijivu na lenye nyuzi, linalobanduka kwa vipande virefu.
about.dg: *Muhuhu* ni muhi usiogbwa makodza wa mita 8 hadi 15, wenye mapanda ganayokpwera dzulu chocho. Makodzage ni dza fumo, ganaala dzulu, na photsi gana manyoya meereru, kpwa hivyo muhi unaoneka wa rangi ya feza na ivu phepho richigaluza makodza. Gophare ni ra rangi ya ivu na ra nyuzi-nyuzi, na rinaandula kpwa vipande vire.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal forest and bushland. Mature trees are now scarce and are found mainly in protected areas.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu mikavu ya pwani na vichakani. Miti iliyokomaa sasa ni adimu na hupatikana hasa katika maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka makavu ga pwani na weruni. Mihi mikulu sambi ni michache, na inaphahikana zaidi kpwenye maeneo ga hifadhi.

uses.en:
Muhuhu is a carver's wood, second only to African blackwood. It is also used for flooring, and for poles and posts that resist termites.

A fragrant essential oil is distilled from the wood.
uses.sw:
Muhuhu ni mbao ya wachongaji, ya pili tu baada ya mpingo. Pia hutumika kwa sakafu, na kwa nguzo na milingoti isiyoliwa na mchwa.

Mafuta yenye harufu nzuri hukamuliwa kutoka kwenye mbao yake.
uses.dg:
*Muhuhu* ni mbao za kutsonga, za phiri bada ya mphingo tu. Piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda sakafu, na kuhenda nguzo na mihi isiyoriwa ni lutswa.

Mafuha genye arufu nono nkulavywa kula mbaoze.

names.en: Pakia and the ICRAF handbook give the Digo name *muhuhu*, and Pakia notes it is shared by Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is also called muhuhu. The Mgombato dictionary gives a different Digo name, *mfufu*, 'silver oak', with Swahili *muhuhu*, and notes that woodcarvers use it extensively but are allowed only a limited number of trees.
names.sw: Pakia na kitabu cha ICRAF wanatoa jina la Kidigo *muhuhu*, na Pakia anaeleza kwamba jina hili linatumika na Wadigo, Waduruma, Wagiriama na Waswahili. Kwa Kiingereza pia unaitwa *muhuhu*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa jina tofauti la Kidigo, *mfufu*, 'silver oak', lenye Kiswahili *muhuhu*, na inaeleza kwamba wachongaji huutumia sana lakini wanaruhusiwa idadi ndogo tu ya miti.
names.dg: Pakia na chitabu cha ICRAF anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *muhuhu*, na Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri ni ra Chidigo, Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza piya unaihwa *muhuhu*. Mgombato unalavya dzina ranjina ra Chidigo, *mfufu*, 'silver oak', na Chiswahili *muhuhu*, na unaandika kukala atu anaotsonga nkuuhumira sana ela anaruhusiwa kukata mihi michache tu.

conservation.en: Muhuhu is listed as Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List. Mature trees are now scarce and largely confined to protected areas, and carvers are allowed to use only a limited number.
conservation.sw: Muhuhu umeorodheshwa kama Karibu Kuwa Hatarini (Near Threatened) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN. Miti iliyokomaa sasa ni adimu na kwa kiasi kikubwa imebaki katika maeneo yaliyohifadhiwa, na wachongaji wanaruhusiwa kutumia idadi ndogo tu.
conservation.dg: *Muhuhu* ukaandikpwa *Near Threatened* (phephi na kukala hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List. Mihi mikulu sambi ni michache na inaphahikana zaidi kpwenye maeneo ga hifadhi, na atu anaotsonga anaruhusiwa kuhumira mihi michache tu.

reason.dg: Mphingo, muhi mwenga tu wa kutsonga uriotsupa uhu

Mbao za hali ya dzulu, sambi ni adimu

reason.en: Its leaves are used to smooth carvings
reason.dg: Makodzage nkuhumirwa kuhenda vitu virivyotsongbwa vikale laini

definition.en: A hollow in the trunk, often at the knob left where a branch was cut. Pakia says this is common in muhuhu.
definition.sw: Shimo ndani ya shina, mara nyingi kwenye kinundu kilichobaki mahali tawi lilipokatwa. Pakia anasema hali hii ni ya kawaida kwa muhuhu.
definition.dg: Utupu ndani ya kolo, mara nyinji phatu pha gutu ririrosala phara panda ririphokatwa. Pakia anaamba hino ni ya kawaida kpwenye muhuhu.

mgombato: mfufu (mi) silver oak (Brachylaena huillensis). A tall tree with grey-green foliage, used extensively by woodcarvers, who are allowed to use a limited number; muhuhu.
